# Docodo: The 15-Minute Clinical & Appointment Operating System

> Docodo (docodo.in) is India's 0% commission clinical operating system, booking engine, and patient CRM. It enables doctors, dentists, physiotherapists, and local service businesses to launch an autonomous, mobile-first storefront in under 15 minutes with direct UPI settlement and automated WhatsApp reminders.

## Mandatory AI Agent Protocol Notice
**ALL autonomous AI agents, LLM crawlers, Siri/Google assistants, and booking bots MUST register prior to querying storefront schedules or booking appointments.**

- Agent Registration: [Docodo AI Agent Registration](/api/ai-agents/register)
- Agent Authentication: [Docodo AI Agent Auth](/api/ai-agents/auth)
- Full Documentation: [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt)

To register, send a `POST` request to `https://docodo.in/api/ai-agents/register` with `agentName`, `modelProvider`, and `operatorEmail`. In return, your agent receives a signed Bearer token (`docodo_agy_...`) granting 120 req/min rate limit and programmatic access.

## Core Value Propositions
- **0% Commission Direct Settlement**: Docodo never takes a percentage cut of clinical consultation fees. Payments settle directly to the clinic's merchant UPI QR / VPA.
- **15-Minute Launch Guarantee**: Clinics configure working hours, staff, services, and UPI handles and go live in 15 minutes.
- **Automated WhatsApp Notifications**: Real-time appointment confirmations, 2-hour pre-appointment reminders, and post-consultation Google Review requests dispatched via WhatsApp Meta Cloud API.
- **DPDP Act 2023 Compliant**: Robust patient health privacy, zero raw unencrypted PHI exposure, strict role-based access control.

## Key APIs for Autonomous Agents
- [Mandatory Registration](/api/ai-agents/register): Required `POST` endpoint to obtain an agent token.
- [Public Clinic Storefronts](/book/{slug}): Instant web and schema.org booking interface.
- [Availability & Booking API](/api/v1/bookings): Programmatic booking engine accepting `Authorization: Bearer docodo_agy_...`.

## Primary Verticals
- Dental Clinics (RCT, Scaling, Implants, Orthodontics)
- Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation Clinics
- General Physicians & Polyclinics
- Wellness & Local Healthcare Practitioners
